traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Martyniaceae: leaves alternate or opposite; leaves simple; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers in racemes; flowers zygomorphic; irregular flowers bilabiate; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 2 to 4; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
